name: sdfb-evaluation
description: Evaluate landed synthetic BigQuery tables against their source and write the evaluation tables. Submits the Dataflow job and returns; read the result from the registry. Every parameter is optional here; the CLI checks that exactly one target is named. The template launcher supplies the runner, project and region itself.

parameters.name: allow_contaminated
parameters.label: Allow contaminated scope
parameters.helpText: Evaluate a scope another writer touched; it stays marked `contaminated`. Empty or false: refuse it.

parameters.name: detection_sample_rows
parameters.label: Detection sample rows
parameters.helpText: Rows per side in the detection (C2ST) sample. Empty: 50000.

parameters.name: disk_size_gb
parameters.label: Worker disk size (GB)
parameters.helpText: Beam's own --disk_size_gb, handed to Beam unchanged: the workers' boot disk. Omit it for Dataflow's default (25 GB with Dataflow Shuffle), which fits the standalone evaluator image. On the repository's shared image (docker/Dockerfile, multi-GB with the GPU libraries) pass 200, the size the generator pins for its own workers: the default overflows while a worker unpacks that image. Never pass it empty; Beam refuses an empty number.

parameters.name: fail_on
parameters.label: Fail-on status
parameters.helpText: Exit 1 when a metric is at this status or worse: none, warn or fail. Empty: none. No effect on a template launch: the template entry never applies it (it submits the job and returns). Read the statuses from the registry instead.

parameters.name: generation_job_id
parameters.label: Generation job id
parameters.helpText: Target: the generation job's Dataflow id. Needs region. Name exactly one of generation_job_id, run_id, tables, seed_table, or give relationships_uri alone; the one exception is a seed_table, which generation_job_id may accompany: it is then the identity of the launch the seed names, and only the Dataflow job is read (for its window; never its log, BigQuery job labels or validation_runs), a job that cannot be read costing the window and a warning. It is not called job_id because the template launcher does not pass a parameter of that name to the pipeline.

parameters.name: label_key_uri
parameters.label: Label key URI
parameters.helpText: The operator's label key: a Secret Manager version (projects/P/secrets/S/versions/V) or a gs:// object. Empty: the key is ephemeral.

parameters.name: landing_dataset
parameters.label: Landing dataset
parameters.helpText: With tables, seed_table, or relationships_uri alone: the dataset (or project.dataset) the tables landed in.

parameters.name: max_bytes_billed
parameters.label: Max bytes billed
parameters.helpText: BigQuery bytes the evaluation may process. Empty: 1099511627776 (1 TiB).

parameters.name: max_shuffle_gb
parameters.label: Max shuffle GB
parameters.helpText: Shuffle the value census may use before it is value-sampled. Empty: 500.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.label: Mode
parameters.helpText: exact: read every row; sampled: a salted sample above sample_rows. Empty: exact on Dataflow.

parameters.name: output_dataset
parameters.label: Output dataset
parameters.helpText: The dataset of the four evaluation tables. Empty: synthetic_data_quality.

parameters.name: output_local
parameters.label: Local output directory
parameters.helpText: Only with the bq_client or local_json sinks, which need a local runner; no effect with the bq sink on Dataflow.

parameters.name: pair_max_columns
parameters.label: Pair max columns
parameters.helpText: Columns whose pairs are compared, per table. Empty: 20.

parameters.name: privacy_sample_rows
parameters.label: Privacy sample rows
parameters.helpText: Rows of the nearest-neighbour privacy sample. Empty: 50000.

parameters.name: reference_dataset
parameters.label: Reference dataset
parameters.helpText: With tables, seed_table, or relationships_uri alone: the dataset (or project.dataset) of their sources, same table names.

parameters.name: reference_rows_limit
parameters.label: Reference rows LIMIT
parameters.helpText: The generation's reference sample size (a positive integer; empty means not given). It sizes the reference panel behind the privacy metrics, which an evaluation named by seed_table, tables or relationships_uri cannot read from the launch's records: without it those metrics are not evaluated.

parameters.name: relationships_uri
parameters.label: Relationships URI
parameters.helpText: The relationship model file or directory (gs://). Given alone (with landing_dataset and reference_dataset) it names the tables: every enabled table of the model, parents first. With seed_table it names the model the seed's component is read from; a URI that holds no model file evaluates the seed alone, with a warning. By generation_job_id it is read only when the launch's own records name none.

parameters.name: row_flags_source_keys
parameters.label: Row flags source keys
parameters.helpText: Row flags carry the matched source key as a keyed hash only. Empty: hashed.

parameters.name: row_flags_top_k
parameters.label: Row flags top-k
parameters.helpText: Row flags kept per check and table. Empty: 100.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.label: Generation run id
parameters.helpText: Target: the generation launch's base run id (validation_runs of output_dataset). Name exactly one of generation_job_id, run_id, tables, seed_table, or give relationships_uri alone.

parameters.name: sample_rows
parameters.label: Sample rows
parameters.helpText: Sampled mode: rows read per side of a table larger than this. Empty: 200000.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.label: Scope
parameters.helpText: How the job's landing rows are isolated. Empty: auto.

parameters.name: sdfb_job
parameters.label: Job kind
parameters.helpText: Pass evaluation when this template is built on the repository's shared image (docker/Dockerfile): its one entry runs generation unless this says evaluation. On the standalone evaluator image (packages/sdfb-evaluation/docker/Dockerfile) the entry is the evaluator itself and the value has no effect.

parameters.name: sink
parameters.label: Sink
parameters.helpText: bq: the pipeline loads BigQuery (the template default on Dataflow). bq_client and local_json write local files and need a local runner. Empty: bq.

parameters.name: seed_table
parameters.label: Seed table
parameters.helpText: Target: the table a launch targeted; evaluates what that launch generated: its enabled component in the relationship model (relationships_uri), or the table alone when no model names it or none is given. Needs landing_dataset and reference_dataset. Name exactly one of generation_job_id, run_id, tables, seed_table, or give relationships_uri alone; generation_job_id may accompany a seed_table (it then says which generation job the row belongs to, and the row takes the job's start and end from the Dataflow API).

parameters.name: tables
parameters.label: Tables
parameters.helpText: Target: landing table names, comma-separated, parents first. Needs landing_dataset and reference_dataset. Name exactly one of generation_job_id, run_id, tables, seed_table, or give relationships_uri alone.

parameters.name: temp_dataset
parameters.label: Temp dataset
parameters.helpText: Where the expiring scope, pin and sample tables go. Empty: output_dataset.

parameters.name: thresholds_uri
parameters.label: Thresholds URI
parameters.helpText: YAML (gs://) of warn/fail thresholds that override the catalogue's for the run: statuses, scores and roll-ups.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.label: Trigger
parameters.helpText: What started the evaluation, recorded in the registry. Empty: cli.

parameters.name: validation_runs_table
parameters.label: validation_runs table FQN
parameters.helpText: The generator's validation-runs table (project.dataset.table; empty means not given). With generation_job_id next to seed_table, this launch's rows of it, found by landing table and the job's window, give the digest that verifies the reference sample, so the metrics that compare with it are evaluated; without it, or when the job's window cannot be read, those metrics are not evaluated and the row says why.
